extracted.intended_audience: trademark examiners, IP classification specialists, trademark attorneys
extracted.subtask_description: Use the Vienna Classification taxonomy to classify figurative elements appearing in trademarks (categories, divisions and sections). This list maps divisions and principal sections (with examples, notes and auxiliary subdivisions) to guide consistent classification of marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 19 — PHORAE, PITCHERS, VASES, FLOWER POTS, FLOWER STANDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level division covering receptacles such as amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots and stands; also large and small containers, bottles, laboratory receptacles, medical apparatus and representations of products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes principal sections 19.1 (Large containers), 19.3 (Small containers), 19.7 (Bottles, flasks), 19.8 (Parts/accessories of bottles), 19.9 (Amphorae, pitchers, vases), 19.11 (Receptacles for laboratory use and for pharmacy), 19.13 (Medical or surgical apparatus, instruments or utensils, prostheses, medicines), and 19.19 (Representations of miscellaneous products). See notes excluding certain hermetically sealed tins or containers classified elsewhere (e.g., 11.3).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.1 LARGE CONTAINERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Large cylindrical or elliptical containers (such as tanks, gas bottles, barrels); large non-cylindrical or non-elliptical containers (such as packing cases, crates, skips); tins and cans, pails, watering cans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: Not including containers classified in 19.9. Not including hermetically sealed tins (19.3.1 or 19.3.3). Auxiliary sections: A 19.1.5–A 19.1.8 (vats, wooden buckets, milking pails), A 19.1.11 (large sacks), A 19.1.12 (baskets), A 19.1.25 (other large containers). Examples like barrels lying horizontally vs upright and different views are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.3 SMALL CONTAINERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Small cylindrical or elliptical containers (such as tubes for pills or for lipsticks, pots for cosmetic cream, preserve tins, jars, cans) and small non-cylindrical or non-elliptical containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: Not including containers classified in 11.3, 19.7, 19.9 or 19.11. Principal sections include 19.3.1 and 19.3.3. Auxiliary sections: letter boxes, sachets (A 19.3.4, A 19.3.5), small open containers (A 19.3.9), tubes or bottles with wrappers (A 19.3.15), tubes pinched at one end (A 19.3.21), paper/card prepared for assembling into small containers (A 19.3.24), other small containers (A 19.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.7 BOTTLES, FLASKS
rubrics_metrics.description: Bottles or flasks in circular/elliptical or other horizontal cross sections; bottles representing human/animal/inanimate forms; bottles or flasks with handle; includes feeding bottles and other shapes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 19.7.1, 19.7.2, 19.7.6, 19.7.7; 19.7.25 Other bottles or flasks; 19.7.26 Feeding bottles. Auxiliary sections cover slender, squat, without neck, with sloping/horizontal neck, inward-curving sides, bulging/protruding sides, conical shape, ribs, surface relief, wicker casing (A 19.7.9–A 19.7.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.8 PARTS OR ACCESSORIES OF BOTTLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts or accessories of bottles, including pouring devices and teats for babies' bottles; explicitly excludes bottle openers and corkscrews (11.1.10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 19.8.1. Auxiliary sections list bottle necks (A 19.8.2), stoppers/corks (A 19.8.5), sealing capsules (A 19.8.7), and other parts/accessories (A 19.8.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.9 AMPHORAE, PITCHERS, VASES, FLOWER POTS, FLOWER STANDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots, flower stands and related variants (with/without handles, decorative vases, plant-growing pots, stands, plant boxes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 19.9.1. Auxiliary sections include amphorae/pitchers (A 19.9.2), vases (A 19.9.3), flower pots (A 19.9.7), flower stands/plant boxes (A 19.9.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.11 RECEPTACLES FOR LABORATORY USE AND FOR PHARMACY
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes mortars (19.11.1) and other receptacles for laboratory use and for pharmacy (19.11.4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: Mortars include kitchen-use mortars. Auxiliary sections: retorts (spherical/ovoid), triangular retorts, balloon flasks, test tubes (A 19.11.5–A 19.11.13) and A 19.11.25 Other receptacles for laboratory use and for pharmacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.13 MEDICAL OR SURGICAL APPARATUS, INSTRUMENTS OR UTENSILS, PROSTHESES, MEDICINES
rubrics_metrics.description: Medical or surgical apparatus, instruments or utensils, prostheses, medicines and related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 19.13.1. Auxiliary sections include hypodermic syringes (A 19.13.3), massage apparatus (A 19.13.5), prostheses (A 19.13.7), condoms (A 19.13.13), plasters/bandages (A 19.13.15), phials/capsules/pills/suppositories (A 19.13.21), stethoscopes (A 19.13.22), and other medical apparatus (A 19.13.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.19 REPRESENTATIONS OF MISCELLANEOUS PRODUCTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Representations of products not classified in other categories/divisions/sections (e.g., coal, coke, briquettes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for product representations that don't fit other classifications within Division 19; no principal subsections listed on this chunk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 20 — WRITING, DRAWING OR PAINTING MATERIALS, OFFICE REQUISITES, STATIONERY AND BOOKSELLERS' GOODS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers writing/drawing/painting materials, small office requisites, papers and documents, books/bookbindings and related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains principal sections 20.1 (writing/drawing materials), 20.5 (papers, documents), 20.7 (books, bookbindings, newspapers). See accompanying notes and auxiliary sections for particular items (e.g., pencils, paint brushes, artist easels, clapperboards, embossed stamps).

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.1 WRITING, DRAWING OR PAINTING MATERIALS, SMALL OFFICE REQUISITES
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes writing, drawing or painting materials, artists' palette knives (except specified exclusions), artists' easels, drawing boards, blackboards, slates and other small office requisites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 20.1.1, 20.1.15, 20.1.17. Notes: includes paper clips, pencil sharpeners, adhesive tape dispensers, inking pads, toner cartridges; excludes drawing pins (14.3.1) and some office requisites (17.5.1 and 20.5 divisions). Auxiliary sections include pencils/pens/fountain pens/felt-tip pens (A 20.1.3), paint brushes (A 20.1.5), painters' rollers (A 20.1.9), clapperboards (A 20.1.16), embossed/rubber stamps (A 20.1.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.5 PAPERS, DOCUMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Parchments, documents bearing handwritten or printed texts or tables, plans/schematic drawings/diagrams/curves/outlines, cards, card indexes, punched cards or tapes, envelopes, visiting cards, tie-on labels, bank/credit/identification cards, postage stamps, bank notes, paper rolls, wallpaper and other papers/documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections enumerated (20.5.1, 20.5.5, 20.5.7, 20.5.11, 20.5.13–20.5.16, 20.5.21, 20.5.23, 20.5.25). Use to classify any document/paper imagery; includes specific items like postage stamps and bank notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.7 BOOKS, BOOKBINDINGS, NEWSPAPERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Books, magazines, newspapers, bookbindings and binders; headings of newspapers or magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 20.7.1. Auxiliary sections include books/magazines/newspapers (A 20.7.2) and bookbindings/binders (A 20.7.5); headings of newspapers/magazines (A 20.7.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 21 — GAMES, TOYS, SPORTING ARTICLES, ROUNDABOUTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers games, toys, sporting articles and playground apparatus like roundabouts and swings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 21.1 (games, toys) and 21.3 (sporting articles, roundabouts). Auxiliary sections list playing cards, dice, draught/chessboards, puzzles, building games, balloons, wind mills, balls, rackets, skis, skates, fishing tackle, nets, goals, targets, boxing gloves, gymnastic apparatus, and other items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 21.1 GAMES, TOYS
rubrics_metrics.description: Packs of cards, playing cards, figures on playing cards, playing dice, dominoes, draughtboards, chessboards, crosswords, chessmen, puzzles, building games, balloons, wind mills, and other games or toys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 21.1.1 and many auxiliaries (A 21.1.2–A 21.1.7 etc.) that specify suits, card figures and combined suit presentations. Note special placement of hearts/clubs in other sections (2.9.1, 5.3.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 21.3 SPORTING ARTICLES, ROUNDABOUTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Footballs and other balls, shuttlecocks, skittles, rackets, golf clubs, hockey sticks, skis, snowboards, skates, skateboards, dumb-bells, cricket equipment, fishing/hunting tackle (including underwater fishing tackle), nets, goals, roundabouts, chutes, swings, targets, boxing gloves, and gymnastic apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections like 21.3.1, 21.3.3, 21.3.5, 21.3.7 etc.; notes exclude arms classified in divisions 23.1 and 23.3 and specific exclusions for items like bows/arrows (24.15), ice-axes, javelins, sailboards (other divisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 22 — MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS AND THEIR ACCESSORIES, MUSIC ACCESSORIES, BELLS, PICTURES, SCULPTURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers musical instruments, accessories, bells, pictures and sculptures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 22.1 (musical instruments and accessories), 22.3 (bells), and 22.5 (pictures, sculptures). Auxiliary subsections enumerate percussion, wind, keyboard, stringed instruments and accessories like drumsticks, bows, tuning forks, metronomes, music stands, cases, pipe organs, lyres/harps, tuning forks.

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.1 MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS, MUSICAL INSTRUMENT ACCESSORIES, MUSIC ACCESSORIES
rubrics_metrics.description: Percussion instruments (22.1.1), wind instruments/whistles (22.1.5), keyboard instruments (22.1.10), stringed instruments (22.1.15), and musical instrument accessories/music accessories (22.1.21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: bells are classified separately (22.3). Accessories include drumsticks, bows, tuning forks, metronomes, instrument holders, music stands, special cases, batons. Auxiliary sections cover brass instruments, hunting horns, woodwind, pipe organs, lyres/harps, tuning forks (A 22.1.6–A 22.1.22).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.3 BELLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Bells (22.3.1), including classifications by number (one, two, three, more than three) and small globular bells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections: one bell (A 22.3.5), two bells (A 22.3.6), three bells (A 22.3.7), more than three bells (A 22.3.8), small globular bells (A 22.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.5 PICTURES, SCULPTURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Pictures and sculptures, including sculptures representing human beings, animals, and other categories; famous pictures and various auxiliary subdivisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 22.5.1 (pictures), 22.5.10 (sculptures representing human beings), 22.5.19 (sculptures representing animals), and 22.5.25 (other sculptures including abstract). Auxiliary sections: famous pictures (A 22.5.3), sculptures by gender/age/group, equestrian sculptures (A 22.5.12–A 22.5.17).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 23 — ARMS, AMMUNITION, ARMOUR
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers side arms and other weapons not being firearms, firearms/ammunition/explosives, and armour; excludes military tanks, aircraft and warships (classified elsewhere).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 23.1 (side arms), 23.3 (firearms/ammunition/explosives), 23.5 (armour). Auxiliary sections list spears, swords, bows/quivers (23.1.1–23.1.7), firearms including cannons, rifles, pistols (A 23.3.2–A 23.3.7), and ammunition types (A 23.3.11–A 23.3.25). Armour auxiliaries include helmets and other parts (A 23.5.5, A 23.5.11).

rubrics_metrics.name: 23.1 SIDE ARMS, OTHER WEAPONS NOT BEING FIREARMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Side arms, spears, swords, daggers (23.1.1); bows and quivers (23.1.5); crossbows (23.1.7); other non-firearm weapons (23.1.25) including clubs, truncheons, boomerangs, catapults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude classification of battle-axes (14.7.2) and specify arrows classification elsewhere (24.15).

rubrics_metrics.name: 23.3 FIREARMS, AMMUNITION, EXPLOSIVES
rubrics_metrics.description: Firearms (23.3.1) and ammunition/explosives (23.3.10), including cannons, rocket launchers, rifles, sub-machine guns, machine guns, pistols, revolvers, and various cartridges, shells, grenades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections detail types of firearms (A 23.3.2–A 23.3.7) and ammunition/explosives (A 23.3.11–A 23.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 23.5 ARMOUR
rubrics_metrics.description: Armour (23.5.1) including parts such as helmets (A 23.5.5) and other parts of armour (A 23.5.11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for heraldic or figurative representations of armour and components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 24 — HERALDRY, COINS, EMBLEMS, SYMBOLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers shields, seals/stamps, medals/coins/decorations/orders, flags, crowns/diadems, emblems/insignia, crosses, arrows, and signs/notations/symbols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 24.1 (shields), 24.3 (seals/stamps), 24.5 (medals/coins), 24.7 (flags), 24.9 (crowns/diadems), 24.11 (emblems/insignia), 24.13 (crosses), 24.15 (arrows), 24.17 (signs/notations/symbols). Auxiliary sections give detailed subtype classifications (e.g., shields with figurative elements, seals circular/elliptical, flags in clusters, crowns closed/open/stylized).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.1 SHIELDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Shields containing no figurative element or inscription, shields with geometric representations, shields with other figurative elements or inscriptions, multiple shields or shields of unusual shape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 24.1.1, 24.1.3, 24.1.5, 24.1.17, 24.1.23, 24.1.25. Auxiliary sections detail shields with heavenly bodies, human figures/parts, animals, plants, landscapes/buildings, manufactured articles, inscriptions, shields surmounted by figurative elements, shields with supporters, etc. (A 24.1.7–A 24.1.20).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.3 SEALS, STAMPS
rubrics_metrics.description: Seals or stamps (24.3.1) including seals/stamps attached to documents, circular, elliptical or other forms, with figurative elements and inscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections cover seals/stamps attached/applied to objects, circular (A 24.3.2), elliptical (A 24.3.7), other forms (A 24.3.8–A 24.3.9), and seals/stamps with representations of heavenly bodies, humans, animals, plants, buildings, manufactured articles, geometrical figures, inscriptions or other figurative elements (A 24.3.11–A 24.3.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.5 MEDALS, COINS, DECORATIONS, ORDERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Single medal or coin (24.5.1), two or more medals/coins (24.5.5, 24.5.7), decorations and orders (24.5.20).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary distinctions include one medal/coin with representation of a human head or being (A 24.5.2), one medal/coin with another figurative element (A 24.5.3), and specific decorations/orders like Golden Fleece (A 24.5.21) and others (A 24.5.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.7 FLAGS
rubrics_metrics.description: One flag (24.7.1) or two or more flags (24.7.3); variants such as flags in clusters, flags in the form of banderoles, several flags on same staff/cable, flags with rounded/tapered/swallow-tail ends, triangular flags, stylized flags.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate clusters (A 24.7.5), banderole forms (A 24.7.11), flags on the same staff (A 24.7.21), and stylized shapes (A 24.7.13–A 24.7.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.9 CROWNS, DIADEMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Crowns closed at the top (24.9.1), crowns open at the top (24.9.2), stylized or fanciful crowns (24.9.3), and diadems (24.9.4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify one crown (A 24.9.5), multiple crowns (A 24.9.6), crowns with spheres on tips, crowns resembling battlements, crowns with triangular points, crowns accompanied by letters/monograms/inscriptions, crowns with figurative elements (human, animal, plant, manufactured articles), and other characteristics (A 24.9.7–A 24.9.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.11 EMBLEMS, INSIGNIA
rubrics_metrics.description: Roman ensigns, lictors’ fasces, sceptres, staves with wings, crooked sticks, Neptune's tridents, globes surmounted by a cross, mitres, Mercury’s helmet, horns of plenty, Chinese symbol of good luck (Ruyi), signs or drawings recognized as emblems or insignia, braids/cockades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections list many specific emblem types (24.11.1–24.11.21) and note exclusions (e.g., chevrons placed in division 26.3.23). A 24.11.25 Other emblems or insignia captures remaining variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.13 CROSSES
rubrics_metrics.description: Various cross forms: Greek/St. Andrew's cross (24.13.1), Latin/tau cross (24.13.2), Cross of Lorraine/Papal cross (24.13.3), Maltese cross (24.13.4), crosses formed by inscriptions (24.13.5), and other crosses (24.13.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections cover crosses formed by intersecting lines, crosses containing inscriptions or figurative elements, crosses with rays/radiating lines, crosses within circles/polygons/squares/rectangles, and other variants (A 24.13.9–A 24.13.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.15 ARROWS
rubrics_metrics.description: One arrow (24.15.1), two arrows (24.15.2), more than two arrows (24.15.3); arrowheads (24.15.21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate arrows with barbs, arrows combined with letters/monograms/numerals or inscriptions or other figurative elements, arrows forming circles/arcs/other geometrical figures, and arrows formed by inscriptions (A 24.15.5–A 24.15.17). Note: excludes arrowheads in the form of angles (26.3.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.17 SIGNS, NOTATIONS, SYMBOLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Punctuation marks (24.17.1), asterisks (24.17.3), mathematical signs (24.17.5), musical symbols (24.17.10), astronomical/astrological signs and zodiac signs, at-symbol (@), currency symbols, yin and yang symbol and other signs, notations or symbols (24.17.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections: dots (A 24.17.2), exclamation/question marks (A 24.17.4); mathematical sign groupings and combinations with figures/letters, infinity symbol (A 24.17.6–A 24.17.9); treble clefs, notes, clefs with stave and other musical symbols (A 24.17.11–A 24.17.14).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 25 — ORNAMENTAL MOTIFS, SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS WITH ORNAMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers ornamental motifs, horizontally elongated ornamental surfaces, backgrounds divided into two or four, surfaces covered with repeated figurative elements or inscriptions, and surfaces covered with other ornaments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 25.1 (ornamental motifs), 25.3 (horizontally elongated ornamental surfaces), 25.5 (backgrounds divided into two or four), 25.7 (surfaces/backgrounds covered with repeated figurative elements or inscriptions), 25.12 (other ornaments). Auxiliary sections provide fine-grained types (bands, borders, labels, frameworks, repeated patterns like lozenges, squares, check patterns, hatching, lines/bands variations).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.1 ORNAMENTAL MOTIFS
rubrics_metrics.description: Frontispieces, ornamental bands and borders, banderoles/cartouches, frameworks and frames, labels/collarettes (bottle-neck labels) and other ornamental motifs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude ornamental motifs composed of plants (division 5.13) and horizontally elongated ornamental surfaces (25.3). Principal sections: 25.1.1, 25.1.5, 25.1.6, 25.1.9, 25.1.15, 25.1.25. Auxiliary subsections include complete/partial frames and bottle collarettes (A 25.1.10–A 25.1.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.3 HORIZONTALLY ELONGATED ORNAMENTAL SURFACES
rubrics_metrics.description: Horizontally elongated surfaces with various short/long side shapes, entasis, elongated polygons, and other elongated surface variants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude elongated elliptical (26.1), triangular (26.3), or quadrilateral (26.4) surfaces. Principal 25.3.1 with auxiliaries A 25.3.3–A 25.3.15 describing convex/concave sides, entasis, arc series sides, and A 25.3.25 Other elongated surfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.5 BACKGROUNDS DIVIDED INTO TWO OR FOUR
rubrics_metrics.description: Backgrounds divided into two (vertically, horizontally, diagonally) or four (crosswise) by lines/bands or areas of different appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 25.5.1–25.5.6 and 25.5.25. Use to classify imagery with bifurcated or quartered backgrounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.7 SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS COVERED WITH REPEATED FIGURATIVE ELEMENTS OR INSCRIPTIONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Surfaces/backgrounds covered with repeated geometrical figures or designs, hatching, repeated inscriptions, lines or bands, or other repeated figurative elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 25.7.1, 25.7.15, 25.7.17, 25.7.20, 25.7.25. Auxiliary subdivisions include lozenge shapes, squares/rectangles, check patterns, polygons, circles/ellipses, dots, and variants of lines/bands (straight, wavy, zigzag/chevron). Note exclusions for scattered leaves/flowers (other divisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.12 SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS COVERED WITH OTHER ORNAMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Surfaces or backgrounds covered with rays or radiating lines, moiré surfaces, or any other ornaments not otherwise classified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 25.12.1, 25.12.3, 25.12.25; use for motifs like radiating lines or moiré patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 26 — GEOMETRICAL FIGURES AND SOLIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of circles, ellipses, segments/sectors, triangles and angle lines, quadrilaterals, other polygons, combinations of different geometrical figures, lines/bands, other geometrical figures/indefinable designs and geometrical solids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 26.1 (circles, ellipses), 26.2 (segments/sectors), 26.3 (triangles), 26.4 (quadrilaterals), 26.5 (other polygons), 26.7 (different geometric figures juxtaposed/joined/intersecting), 26.11 (lines, bands), 26.13 (other geometrical figures/indefinable designs), 26.15 (geometrical solids). Auxiliary sections enumerate contained figures, inscriptions, dark surfaces, numerals/letters, orientation and other specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.1 CIRCLES, ELLIPSES
rubrics_metrics.description: Circles (26.1.1), ellipses (26.1.2), multiple concentric circles/ellipses, juxtaposed/intersecting circles/ellipses, circles/ellipses containing triangles/quadrilaterals/other geometrical figures, circles/ellipses with inscriptions/numerals/letters or dark surfaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 26.1.3–A 26.1.24 cover one circle/ellipse, circles containing heavenly bodies/humans/animals/plants/figurative elements/numerals/letters, inscriptions projecting beyond circumference, inscriptions arranged along radius/diameter or circularly, and dark surfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.2 SEGMENTS OR SECTORS OF CIRCLES OR ELLIPSES
rubrics_metrics.description: Segments or sectors of circles/ellipses, joined/intersecting segments/sectors, semi-circles/semi-ellipses including those with letters or dark surfaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 26.2.1–26.2.7 and auxiliaries A 26.2.8–A 26.2.9 for semi-circles/semi-ellipses containing letters or with dark surface.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.3 TRIANGLES, LINES FORMING AN ANGLE
rubrics_metrics.description: One triangle (26.3.1), two/three/more triangles (26.3.2–26.3.4, 26.3.10), triangles containing circles/ellipses/polygons/other figures, lines or bands forming an angle (26.3.23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliaries cover triangles pointing downwards, convex/concave sides, truncated/rounded angles, triangles containing figurative elements/heavenly bodies/humans/animals/plants/numerals/letters/inscriptions/dark surfaces (A 26.3.5–A 26.3.24). Note inclusion of chevrons and arrowheads formed by lines/bands.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.4 QUADRILATERALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Squares (26.4.1), rectangles (26.4.2), rhombs, irregular parallelograms/trapezia/quadrilaterals containing other figures, multiple quadrilaterals (26.4.7–26.4.9), quadrilaterals containing circles/ellipses/triangles/other figures (26.4.10–26.4.12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include one quadrilateral (A 26.4.5), quadrilaterals with convex/concave sides (A 26.4.6), quadrilaterals containing heavenly bodies/humans/animals/plants/figurative elements/numerals/letters/inscriptions/dark surfaces (A 26.4.13–A 26.4.24). Note exclusion of elongated surfaces classified in 25.3.1.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.5 OTHER POLYGONS
rubrics_metrics.description: One polygon (26.5.1), two polygons one inside another, several polygons juxtaposed/inside one another, polygons with truncated/rounded angles, polygons containing circles/ellipses/triangles/quadrilaterals/other figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 26.5.1–26.5.12 and auxiliaries A 26.5.6, A 26.5.13–A 26.5.24 define polygons with figurative inclusions (heavenly bodies, humans, animals, plants), numerals/letters, inscriptions projecting beyond circumference, dark surfaces, and other variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.7 DIFFERENT GEOMETRICAL FIGURES, JUXTAPOSED, JOINED OR INTERSECTING
rubrics_metrics.description: Combinations of circles/ellipses with segments/sectors/triangles/quadrilaterals/other polygons and other pairings of different geometrical figures; includes complex combinations of more than two different geometrical figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 26.7.1–26.7.19 and 26.7.25 cover many combinations (circles with segments, triangles with quadrilaterals, segments with polygons, etc.). Use for composite geometric motifs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.11 LINES, BANDS
rubrics_metrics.description: One line or band (26.11.1), two lines or bands (26.11.2), more than two lines or bands (26.11.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 26.11.5–A 26.11.14, A 26.11.21, A 26.11.25 cover thin lines, thick bands, vertical/horizontal/oblique/straight/curved/broken/wavy/zigzag/dotted lines, sets of lines evoking speed/propulsion, and other line/band types.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.13 OTHER GEOMETRICAL FIGURES, INDEFINABLE DESIGNS
rubrics_metrics.description: Stains, spots, blots and other geometrical figures or indefinable designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 26.13.1 and 26.13.25 for residual/indefinable geometric motifs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.15 GEOMETRICAL SOLIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Geometrical solids such as spheres (26.15.1), cylinders (26.15.3), cones (26.15.5), pyramids (26.15.7), cubes (26.15.9), parallelepipeds (26.15.11), prisms (26.15.13), other polyhedrons and other geometrical solids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections enumerate common 3D solids and a catch-all for other solids (26.15.15, 26.15.25). Use when the mark depicts polyhedral or solid figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division 27 — FORMS OF WRITING, NUMERALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers letters or numerals forming geometrical figures or written/typographical matter in perspective, letters/numerals representing humans/animals/plants/objects, letters presenting special forms of writing, numerals presenting special forms of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 27.1 (letters/numerals forming geometrical figures or in perspective), 27.3 (letters/numerals representing beings/objects). Auxiliary subsections list many geometrical figure forms letters/numerals can form (squares, rectangles, polygons, arcs, plano-convex/concave, biconvex/biconcave, bands with wavy/zigzag sides, perspective forms).

rubrics_metrics.name: 27.1 LETTERS OR NUMERALS FORMING GEOMETRICAL FIGURES, WRITTEN OR TYPOGRAPHICAL MATTER IN PERSPECTIVE
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes single letters/numerals or groups forming squares, rectangles, other quadrilaterals, polygons, triangles, circles, ellipses, plano-convex/concave, biconvex/biconcave figures, arcs, bands with wavy/zigzag sides and letters/numerals in perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 27.1.1 with auxiliaries A 27.1.2–A 27.1.25 that enumerate specific shape-formations, letters/numerals in perspective (decreasing towards center or extremities), and other geometrical configurations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 27.3 LETTERS OR NUMERALS REPRESENTING A HUMAN BEING, AN ANIMAL, A PLANT OR AN OBJECT
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters, numerals or punctuation marks representing a human being or parts of a human body, an animal or parts of an animal’s body, a plant or an object, applicable to single characters or groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 27.3.1. Notes: includes punctuation marks used representationally; applies to single or groups of letters/numerals/punctuation. Auxiliary sections (not shown in chunk) enumerate finer distinctions.
